translations.literal: Qiu branded cunning clerks and banned illicit coining;
translations.idiomatic: Qiu branded cunning clerks and forbade illicit coinage;

sentences.zh: 卞以身活人；

translations.literal: Bian used his own body to save another's life;
translations.idiomatic: Bian risked his own life to save another;

sentences.zh: 瓌不貢羨財；

translations.literal: Gui did not offer surplus tribute funds;
translations.idiomatic: Gui refused to send up surplus tribute money;

sentences.zh: 景憲因母死而髮白；

translations.literal: Jingxian's hair turned white upon his mother's death;
translations.idiomatic: Jingxian's hair turned white when his mother died;

sentences.zh: 孫瑜不忍以父喪而得官，此其行尤昭昭者歟。

translations.literal: Sun Yu could not bear to obtain office because of his father's mourning — of their conduct these were especially shining, were they not?
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yu could not bear to gain office through his father's mourning — among their deeds, were these not the brightest of all?

sentences.zh: 許遵，字仲塗，泗州人，第進士，又中明法，擢大理寺詳斷官、知長興縣。

translations.literal: Xu Zun, styled Zhongtu, was a man of Sizhou; he placed in the jinshi examination, also passed the mingfa examination, and was promoted to detailed adjudication officer of the Court of Judicial Review and prefect of Changxing County.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zun, whose courtesy name was Zhongtu, came from Sizhou. He placed in the jinshi examination and also passed the examination in statutory law, then was promoted to detailed adjudication officer of the Court of Judicial Review and appointed prefect of Changxing County.

sentences.zh: 水災，民多流徙，遵募民出米振濟，竟以無患。

translations.literal: During a flood disaster many people fled; Zun recruited people to contribute rice for relief, and in the end there was no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: When floods struck and many people were displaced, Zun recruited the people to contribute rice for relief, and in the end the district suffered no further harm.

sentences.zh: 益興水利，溉田甚博，邑人便利，立石紀之。

translations.literal: He further promoted waterworks, irrigating fields on a very broad scale; the county people benefited, and a stone monument was erected to record it.
translations.idiomatic: He expanded irrigation works on a broad scale, greatly benefiting the people of the county, who erected a stone monument to commemorate the achievement.

sentences.zh: 為審刑院詳議官，知宿州、登州。

translations.literal: He served as detailed deliberation officer of the Office of Scrutiny and Review, and was prefect of Suzhou and Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as detailed deliberation officer of the Office of Scrutiny and Review, and was prefect of Suzhou and Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 遵累典刑獄，強敏明恕。

translations.literal: Zun repeatedly presided over penal cases, vigorous, perceptive, enlightened, and forgiving.
translations.idiomatic: Zun repeatedly presided over criminal cases, combining forceful intelligence with enlightened clemency.

sentences.zh: 及為登州，執政許以判大理，遵欲立奇以自鬻。

translations.literal: When he became prefect of Dengzhou, the chief ministers promised him the post of administrator of the Court of Judicial Review; Zun wished to establish a remarkable precedent to sell himself.
translations.idiomatic: When he became prefect of Dengzhou, the chief ministers had promised him the post of administrator of the Court of Judicial Review, and Zun wished to make a striking legal ruling to advance himself.

sentences.zh: 會婦人阿云獄起。

translations.literal: It happened that the case of the woman A Yun arose.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the case of the woman A Yun arose.

sentences.zh: 初，云許嫁未行，嫌婿陋，伺其寢田舍，懷刀斫之，十餘創，不能殺，斷其一指。

translations.literal: At first, Yun had been betrothed but the marriage had not yet taken place; disliking her fiancé's ugliness, she waited until he was sleeping in a farmhouse, concealed a knife and hacked at him — more than ten wounds — but could not kill him, and severed one of his fingers.
translations.idiomatic: At first Yun had been betrothed, though the marriage had not yet taken place. Finding her fiancé ugly, she waited until he was asleep in a farmhouse, then drew a knife and hacked at him more than ten times. She failed to kill him but severed one of his fingers.

sentences.zh: 吏求盜弗得，疑云所為，執而詰之，欲加訊掠，乃吐實。

translations.literal: Officials sought the robber but could not find him; suspecting Yun had done it, they seized and questioned her; intending to apply torture under interrogation, she then confessed the truth.
translations.idiomatic: Officials searched for the assailant in vain, suspected Yun, seized and questioned her, and were about to apply torture under interrogation when she confessed.

sentences.zh: 遵按云納采之日，母服未除，應以凡人論，讞於朝。

translations.literal: Zun investigated and held that on the day Yun received betrothal gifts, her mourning for her mother had not yet ended; she should be treated as an ordinary person; he submitted the verdict to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Zun held that on the day betrothal gifts were received, Yun was still in mourning for her mother and should be judged as an ordinary person rather than as a wife; he submitted his verdict to the court.

sentences.zh: 有司當為謀殺已傷，遵駁言：「云被問即承，應為按問。

translations.literal: The relevant office assessed the crime as plotted murder with injury inflicted; Zun objected, saying, "Yun confessed as soon as she was questioned; this should be treated as conversation under interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices assessed the crime as attempted murder with injury, but Zun objected: "Yun confessed as soon as she was questioned; the case should be treated as confession under interrogation.

sentences.zh: 審刑、大理當絞刑，非是。

translations.literal: The Office of Scrutiny and Review and the Court of Judicial Review assessed strangulation — this is not correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Scrutiny and Review and the Court of Judicial Review assessed strangulation — that is wrong.

sentences.zh: 」事下刑部，以遵為妄，詔以贖論。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the Ministry of Justice, which deemed Zun's view presumptuous; an edict ordered redemption as punishment.
translations.idiomatic: " The case was sent down to the Ministry of Justice, which judged Zun's argument reckless; an edict ordered that he be punished by redemption.

sentences.zh: 未幾，果判大理。

translations.literal: Before long, he did indeed become administrator of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was indeed appointed administrator of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 恥用議法坐劾，復言：「刑部定議非直，云合免所因之罪。

translations.literal: Ashamed at being impeached for using deliberative law, he again said, "The Ministry of Justice's determination is not upright; Yun should be exempted from punishment for the crime that was the cause.
translations.idiomatic: Humiliated at being impeached for invoking deliberative law, he argued again: "The Ministry of Justice's ruling is unjust; Yun should be exempted from punishment for the underlying offense.

sentences.zh: 今棄敕不用，但引斷例，一切按而殺之，塞其自守之路，殆非罪疑惟輕之義。

translations.literal: Now they discard the edicts and do not use them, but merely cite precedent cases and universally treat cases as anjian and execute — blocking the path of self-preservation — this is hardly the principle of treating doubtful guilt with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Now they set aside the edicts and rely only on precedent, treating every such case as confession under interrogation and imposing death — cutting off the path by which the accused may defend themselves. That can hardly accord with the principle that doubtful guilt should be treated leniently.

sentences.zh: 」詔司馬光、王安石議。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Sima Guang and Wang Anshi to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Sima Guang and Wang Anshi to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 光以為不可，安石主遵，御史中丞滕甫、侍御史錢顗皆言遵所爭戾法意，自是廷論紛然。

translations.literal: Guang considered it impermissible; Anshi supported Zun; Censor-in-Chief Teng Fu and Attending Censor Qian Yi both said Zun's contention ran counter to the intent of the law; from then on court debate became clamorous.
translations.idiomatic: Guang held that this could not be allowed; Anshi supported Zun; Censor-in-Chief Teng Fu and Attending Censor Qian Yi both said Zun's argument ran counter to the spirit of the law; from then on the court was torn by dispute.

sentences.zh: 安石既執政，悉罪異己者，遂從遵議。

translations.literal: Once Anshi took power, he punished all who differed from him, and thus followed Zun's opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Once Anshi came to power, he punished all who opposed him and adopted Zun's position.

sentences.zh: 雖累問不承者，亦得為按問。

translations.literal: Even those who did not confess after repeated questioning could be treated as anjian.
translations.idiomatic: Even those who did not confess after repeated questioning could be treated as having confessed under interrogation.

sentences.zh: 或兩人同為盜劫，吏先問左，則按問在左；

translations.literal: If two people together committed robbery, and officials first questioned the one on the left, then anjian applied to the one on the left;
translations.idiomatic: If two men had committed robbery together and officials questioned the one on the left first, confession under interrogation applied to the one on the left;

sentences.zh: 先問右，則按問在右。

translations.literal: if they first questioned the one on the right, then anjian applied to the one on the right.
translations.idiomatic: if they questioned the one on the right first, it applied to the one on the right.

sentences.zh: 獄之生死，在問之先後，而非盜之情，天下益厭其說。

translations.literal: Whether a case meant life or death depended on the order of questioning, not on the circumstances of the robbery; throughout the realm people grew ever more weary of this doctrine.
translations.idiomatic: Whether a prisoner lived or died depended on the order in which he was questioned, not on the facts of the robbery, and people throughout the empire grew ever more disgusted with the doctrine.

sentences.zh: 熙寧間，出知壽州，再判大理寺，請知潤州，又請提舉崇福宮。

translations.literal: During the Xining era, he went out as prefect of Shouzhou, again served as administrator of the Court of Judicial Review, requested appointment as prefect of Runzhou, and again requested to oversee Chongfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining era he went out as prefect of Shouzhou, served again as administrator of the Court of Judicial Review, requested appointment as prefect of Runzhou, and later asked to oversee Chongfu Palace.

sentences.zh: 尋致仕，累官中散大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he retired, having cumulatively reached Grand Master of Palace Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired, having risen to Grand Master of Palace Attendance.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died at age eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 盧士宗

translations.literal: Lu Shizong
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shizong

sentences.zh: 盧士宗，字公彥，濰州昌樂人。

translations.literal: Lu Shizong, styled Gongyan, was a man of Changle in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shizong, whose courtesy name was Gongyan, came from Changle in Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 舉《五經》，歷審刑院詳議、編敕刪定官，提點江西刑獄。

translations.literal: He passed the 《Five Classics》 examination, served successively as detailed deliberation officer of the Office of Scrutiny and Review and as an editor-reviser of the statutory codes, and was intendant of penal affairs for Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the examination in the 《Five Classics》, served successively as detailed deliberation officer of the Office of Scrutiny and Review and as an editor-reviser of the statutory codes, and was intendant of penal affairs for Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 侍講楊安國以經術薦之，仁宗御延和殿，詔講官悉升殿聽其講《易》。

translations.literal: Lecturer Yang Anguo recommended him for his mastery of the classics; Emperor Renzong held court at the Yanhe Hall and ordered all lecturing officials to ascend the hall to hear him lecture on the 《Changes》.
translations.idiomatic: Lecturer Yang Anguo recommended him for his mastery of the classics; Emperor Renzong held court in the Yanhe Hall and ordered all lecturing officials to ascend and hear him expound the Changes.

sentences.zh: 明日，復命講《泰卦》，又召經筵官及僕射賈昌朝聽之。

translations.literal: The next day he was again ordered to lecture on the 《Tai》 hexagram, and palace lecture officials and Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Jia Changchao were summoned to listen.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he was again ordered to lecture on the 《Tai》 hexagram, and the palace lecture officials and Vice Director Jia Changchao were summoned to listen.

sentences.zh: 授天章閣侍講，賜三品服，加直龍圖閣、天章閣待制、判流內銓。

translations.literal: He was appointed Lecturer at the Tianzhang Pavilion, granted third-rank robes, additionally made a direct associate of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, appointee at the Tianzhang Pavilion, and administrator of the Internal Appointments Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Lecturer at the Tianzhang Pavilion, granted third-rank robes, made a direct associate of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and appointee at the Tianzhang Pavilion, and put in charge of the Internal Appointments Bureau.

sentences.zh: 李參、郭申錫有決河訟，詔士宗劾之。

translations.literal: Li Can and Guo Shenxi had a lawsuit over river-control decisions; an edict ordered Shizong to investigate them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Can and Guo Shenxi were embroiled in a lawsuit over river-control decisions; an edict ordered Shizong to investigate them.

sentences.zh: 士宗言兩人皆為時用，有罪當驗問，不宜逮鞫。

translations.literal: Shizong said both men were then in active use; if guilty they should be examined and questioned, and they should not be immediately arrested and interrogated.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong said both men were then in active service; if they were guilty they should be examined and questioned, and should not be immediately arrested and interrogated.

sentences.zh: 於是但黜申錫為州。

translations.literal: Thereupon only Shenxi was demoted to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon only Shenxi was demoted to serve as a prefect.

sentences.zh: 進龍圖閣直學士、知審刑院、通進銀臺司。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, administrator of the Office of Scrutiny and Review, and overseer of the Silver Terrace Office of Memorial Submission.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, made administrator of the Office of Scrutiny and Review, and put in charge of the Silver Terrace Office of Memorial Submission.

sentences.zh: 仁宗神主祔廟，禮院請以太祖、太宗為一世，而增一室以備天子事七世之禮。

translations.literal: When Emperor Renzong's spirit tablet was placed in the ancestral temple, the Board of Rites requested treating Taizu and Taizong as one generation and adding one chamber to satisfy the rite by which the Son of Heaven serves seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Renzong's spirit tablet was placed in the ancestral temple, the Board of Rites proposed treating Taizu and Taizong as one generation and adding a chamber so that the Son of Heaven might observe the rite of serving seven generations.

sentences.zh: 詔兩制與禮官考議，孫抃等欲如之，士宗以為：「在禮，太祖之廟，萬世不毀；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hanlin academicians and ritual officials to investigate and deliberate; Sun Bian and others wished to do as proposed; Shizong held that: "According to ritual, Taizu's temple is never to be destroyed for ten thousand generations;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hanlin academicians and ritual officials to investigate and deliberate. Sun Bian and others wished to follow the proposal, but Shizong argued: "According to ritual, Taizu's temple is never to be destroyed;

sentences.zh: 其餘昭穆，親盡即毀，示有終也。

translations.literal: the rest in the zhao and mu sequence, when affinity is exhausted, are destroyed — showing that there is an end.
translations.idiomatic: the rest in the zhao and mu sequence, when the bond of kinship is exhausted, are removed — showing that even reverence has its limit.

sentences.zh: 自漢以來，天子受命之初，太祖尚在三昭、三穆之次，祀四世或六世，其以上之主，屬雖尊於太祖，親盡則遷。

translations.literal: Since Han times, at the beginning when a Son of Heaven received the Mandate, the dynastic founder was still in the sequence of the three zhao and three mu; four or six generations were served; ancestors above that, though in rank more honored than the founder, when affinity was exhausted were relocated.
translations.idiomatic: Since Han times, when a new Son of Heaven received the Mandate, the dynastic founder still stood within the sequence of the three zhao and three mu; four or six generations were served, and ancestors above that, though more exalted in rank than the founder, were relocated once kinship was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 故漢元帝之世，瘞太上廟主於國，魏明帝遷處士主於國邑，晉武、惠祔廟，遷征西、豫章府君。

translations.literal: Thus in the reign of Emperor Yuan of Han, the spirit tablet of the Grand August was buried in the state; in the reign of Emperor Ming of Wei, the spirit tablet of the Founding Lord was moved to the state fief; when Emperors Wu and Hui of Jin placed tablets in the temple, the Lord of Western Expedition and the Lord of Yuzhang were relocated.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in the reign of Emperor Yuan of Han the spirit tablet of the Grand August was buried in the state; in the reign of Emperor Ming of Wei the spirit tablet of the Founding Lord was moved to the state fief; and when Emperors Wu and Hui of Jin placed their tablets in the temple, the Lord of Western Expedition and the Lord of Yuzhang were relocated.

sentences.zh: 大抵過六世則遷其主，蓋太祖已正東向之位，則並三昭三穆為七世矣。

translations.literal: In general, after six generations the spirit tablet was relocated — for once the dynastic founder had taken the correct east-facing position, the three zhao and three mu together made seven generations.
translations.idiomatic: In general, once six generations had passed the spirit tablet was relocated, for once the dynastic founder had taken the correct east-facing position, the three zhao and three mu together constituted seven generations.

sentences.zh: 唐高祖初祀四世，太宗增祀六世，太宗祔廟則遷弘農府君，高宗祔廟又遷宣宗，皆前世成法，惟明皇九廟祀八世，於事為不經。

translations.literal: Tang Gaozu at first served four generations; Taizong increased it to six; when Taizong's tablet was placed in the temple the Lord of Hongnong was relocated; when Gaozong's tablet was placed, Emperor Xuanzong was relocated — all precedents from earlier ages; only Emperor Ming of Tang with nine temples serving eight generations was irregular in practice.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Gaozu at first served four generations; Taizong increased the number to six; when Taizong's tablet was placed in the temple the Lord of Hongnong was relocated, and when Gaozong's tablet was placed Emperor Xuanzong was relocated — all precedents from earlier ages. Only Emperor Ming of Tang, with nine temples serving eight generations, departed from established practice.

sentences.zh: 今大行祔廟，僖祖親盡當遷，於典禮為合，不當添展一室。

translations.literal: Now when the late emperor's tablet is placed in the temple, Prince Xi as affinity is exhausted should be relocated; this accords with canonical ritual, and one should not add and extend a chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the late emperor's tablet is to be placed in the temple, Prince Xi, whose kinship bond is exhausted, should be relocated; that accords with canonical ritual, and one should not add another chamber.

sentences.zh: 」詔抃等再議，卒從八室之說，議者咎之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Bian and others to deliberate again; in the end they followed the eight-chamber proposal, and critics blamed them.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Bian and the others to deliberate again; in the end they adopted the eight-chamber proposal, and critics blamed them for it.

sentences.zh: 出知青州，入辭，英宗曰：「學士忠純之操，朕所素知，豈當久處外。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Qingzhou; on taking leave to bid farewell, Emperor Yingzong said, "Your loyal and pure character, Academician, is what I have long known — how could you long remain outside the capital?
translations.idiomatic: When he went out as prefect of Qingzhou and came to take leave, Emperor Yingzong said, "Your loyal and upright character, Academician, is something I have long known — how could you long remain outside the capital?

sentences.zh: 」命再對，及見，論知人安民之要，勸帝守祖宗法。

translations.literal: " He was ordered to audience again; when he appeared, he discussed the essentials of knowing men and pacifying the people, and urged the emperor to keep to the laws of the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: " He was ordered to audience again; when he appeared, he discussed the essentials of knowing men and pacifying the people, and urged the emperor to uphold the laws of the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 御史言其罕通吏事，且衰病，改沂州。

translations.literal: Censors said he rarely understood administrative affairs and was moreover frail and ill; he was transferred to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Censors said he had little grasp of administrative affairs and was moreover frail and ill; he was transferred to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，以禮部侍郎致仕，卒，年七十一。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining he retired as Vice Minister of Rites and died at age seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xining era he retired as Vice Minister of Rites and died at seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 士宗以儒者長刑名之學，而主於仁恕，故在刑部審刑，前後十數年。

translations.literal: Shizong, as a Confucian, excelled in the study of penal law yet upheld benevolence and clemency; thus in the Ministry of Justice and the Office of Scrutiny and Review he served for more than ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong, though a Confucian scholar, excelled in penal law yet upheld benevolence and clemency; for that reason he served in the Ministry of Justice and the Office of Scrutiny and Review for more than ten years in all.

sentences.zh: 錢象先

translations.literal: Qian Xiangxian
translations.idiomatic: Qian Xiangxian

sentences.zh: 錢象先，字資元，蘇州人。

translations.literal: Qian Xiangxian, styled Ziyuan, was a man of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Xiangxian, whose courtesy name was Ziyuan, came from Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 進士高第，呂夷簡薦為國子監直講，歷權大理少卿、度支判官、河北、江東轉運使，召兼天章閣侍講。

translations.literal: He placed at the top of the jinshi examination; Lü Yijian recommended him as direct lecturer at the Directorate of Education; he served successively as acting Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, assistant fiscal commissioner, transport commissioner of Hebei and Jiangdong, and was summoned concurrently as lecturer at the Tianzhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He graduated at the top of the jinshi examination. Lü Yijian recommended him as direct lecturer at the Directorate of Education; he served successively as acting Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, assistant fiscal commissioner, transport commissioner of Hebei and Jiangdong, and was summoned concurrently as lecturer at the Tianzhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 詳定一路敕成，當進勳爵，仁宗以象先母老，欲慰之，獨賜紫章服。

translations.literal: When the task of reviewing and finalizing a circuit's statutory codes was completed he was due to receive a merit noble rank; Emperor Renzong, because Xiangxian's mother was elderly and wishing to comfort him, alone granted him purple official robes.
translations.idiomatic: When the task of reviewing and finalizing a circuit's statutory codes was completed he was due to receive a merit noble rank, but Emperor Renzong, knowing Xiangxian's mother was elderly and wishing to comfort him, granted him purple official robes instead.

sentences.zh: 進待制、知審刑院，加龍圖閣直學士，出知蔡州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to appointee, administrator of the Office of Scrutiny and Review, additionally made Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, and went out as prefect of Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to appointee and administrator of the Office of Scrutiny and Review, made Direct Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, and sent out as prefect of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 象先長於經術，侍邇英十餘年，有所顧問，必依經以對，反復諷諭，遂及當世之務，帝禮遇甚渥。

translations.literal: Xiangxian excelled in classical learning; he attended at the Erying Hall for more than ten years; whenever consulted he always answered according to the classics, repeatedly admonishing by indirection until the affairs of the present age were reached; the emperor treated him with great honor.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangxian excelled in classical learning and attended at the Erying Hall for more than ten years. Whenever the emperor consulted him he answered from the classics, admonishing by indirection until the discussion reached the affairs of the day; the emperor treated him with great honor.

sentences.zh: 故事，講讀官分日迭進，象先已得蔡，帝猶諭之曰：「大夫行有日矣，宜講徹一編。

translations.literal: By precedent lecturing and reading officials entered on alternating days; Xiangxian had already been appointed to Caizhou, yet the emperor still instructed him, "Your departure, Grand Master, is near; you ought to finish lecturing through one complete text.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the lecturing and reading officials entered on alternating days. Xiangxian had already been appointed to Caizhou, yet the emperor still told him, "Your departure, Grand Master, is near; you ought to finish lecturing through one complete text.

sentences.zh: 」於是同列罷進者浹日。

translations.literal: " Thereupon his colleagues who had ceased entering lectured continuously for days.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon his colleagues who had ceased entering lectured day after day without interruption.

sentences.zh: 徙知河南府、陳州，復兼侍講、知審刑院。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Henan Prefecture and Chenzhou, and again served concurrently as lecturer and administrator of the Office of Scrutiny and Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Henan Prefecture and Chenzhou, and again served concurrently as lecturer and administrator of the Office of Scrutiny and Review.

sentences.zh: 象先旁通法家說，故屢為刑官，條令多所裁定。

translations.literal: Xiangxian was also versed in Legalist doctrines; therefore he repeatedly served as a penal official and adjudicated many provisions of the code.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangxian was also versed in Legalist doctrine; for that reason he repeatedly served as a penal official and adjudicated many provisions of the code.

sentences.zh: 嘗以為犯敕者重，犯令者輕，請移敕文入令者甚眾。

translations.literal: He once held that violating an edict was serious while violating an ordinance was light, and requested that many edict provisions be moved into ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: He once argued that violating an edict was a serious offense while violating an ordinance was a lesser one, and requested that many edict provisions be moved into ordinances.

sentences.zh: 又議告捕法，以為罪有可去，有可捕，苟皆許捕，則奸人將倚法以害善良，因削去許捕百餘事。

translations.literal: He also deliberated on the law of reporting and apprehension, holding that some offenses could be waived and some could be pursued; if all were permitted to be pursued, wicked men would rely on the law to harm the good; therefore more than a hundred permitted-apprehension items were cut.
translations.idiomatic: He also deliberated on the law of reporting and apprehension, arguing that some offenses could be waived and some pursued; if every offense were permitted to be pursued, wicked men would use the law to harm the innocent, and so more than a hundred permitted-apprehension items were removed.

sentences.zh: 其持心平恕類此。

translations.literal: His even-minded clemency was of this kind throughout.
translations.idiomatic: His even-handed clemency was of this kind throughout.

sentences.zh: 復知許、潁、陳三州，以吏部侍郎致仕。

translations.literal: He again served as prefect of Xu, Ying, and Chen, and retired as Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as prefect of Xu, Ying, and Chen, and retired as Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died at age eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 韓璹，字君玉，衛州汲人。

translations.literal: Han Jun, styled Junyu, was a man of Ji in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jun, whose courtesy name was Junyu, came from Ji in Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，知定州安喜縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and served as magistrate of Anxi in Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and served as magistrate of Anxi in Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 為政強力，能使吏不賄，守韓琦稱其才。

translations.literal: In governing he was forceful and effective, able to keep clerks from taking bribes; Prefect Han Qi praised his talent.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he was forceful and effective, able to keep clerks from taking bribes; Prefect Han Qi praised his ability.

sentences.zh: 為開封司錄。

translations.literal: He served as recorder of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He served as recorder of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐寬恤諸道，分遣使者。

translations.literal: During the Jiayou era of clemency and relief for the various circuits, envoys were dispatched separately.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiayou era of clemency and relief, envoys were dispatched to the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 璹曰：「京師諸夏本，顧獨不蒙惠乎？

translations.literal: Jun said, "The capital is the root of all the Xia lands — yet alone it receives no benefit?
translations.idiomatic: Jun said, "The capital is the root of all the realm — yet alone it receives no relief?

sentences.zh: 」乃具徭役利害上之，詔司馬光、陳洙詳定條式，遂革大姓漁并之弊。

translations.literal: " He then set forth the advantages and harms of corvée labor and submitted it upward; an edict ordered Sima Guang and Chen Zhu to review and establish the regulations, and the abuse of great clans preying on and swallowing up others was reformed.
translations.idiomatic: " He then submitted a detailed account of the advantages and harms of corvée labor; an edict ordered Sima Guang and Chen Zhu to review and establish the regulations, and the abuse by great clans of preying on and swallowing up others was reformed.

sentences.zh: 提點利州路、河北刑獄，以開封府判官迎契丹使。

translations.literal: He was intendant of penal affairs for Lizhou Circuit and Hebei, and as an administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture received the Khitan envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was intendant of penal affairs for Lizhou Circuit and Hebei, and as an administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture received the Khitan envoy.

sentences.zh: 使問：「南朝不聞打圍，何也？

translations.literal: The envoy asked, "In the Southern Court one never hears of hunting enclosures — why?
translations.idiomatic: The envoy asked, "In the Southern Court one never hears of the hunt enclosure — why is that?

sentences.zh: 」璹曰：「我后仁及昆蟲，非時不為耳。」

translations.literal: " Jun said, "Our sovereign's benevolence extends even to insects; she simply does not do it out of season."
translations.idiomatic: " Jun replied, "Our sovereign's benevolence extends even to insects; she simply does not hunt out of season."

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，為梓州路轉運使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining he was transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xining era he was transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 朝廷命諸道議更役法，璹首建併綱減役之制，綱以數計者百二十有八，衙前以人計者二百八十有三，省役人五百。

translations.literal: The court ordered the various circuits to deliberate on revising corvée law; Jun was the first to propose a system of merging categories and reducing corvée: categories counted by number totaled one hundred twenty-eight; yamen runners counted by persons totaled two hundred eighty-three; corvée personnel were reduced by five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the various circuits to deliberate on revising corvée law; Jun was the first to propose a system of merging categories and reducing corvée: one hundred twenty-eight categories by number, two hundred eighty-three yamen runners by headcount, and a reduction of five hundred corvée laborers.

sentences.zh: 又請裁定諸州衙簿，於是王安石言：「璹所言皆久為公私病，監司背公養譽，莫之或恤，而獨能體上意，宜加賞。

translations.literal: He also requested that yamen registers in the various prefectures be fixed; thereupon Wang Anshi said, "What Jun proposes has long been a public and private affliction; supervisory commissioners turn their backs on the public to cultivate reputation, and none show concern, yet he alone can embody the emperor's intent — he should receive added reward.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested that yamen registers in the various prefectures be fixed. Thereupon Wang Anshi said, "What Jun proposes has long afflicted both public and private interests; supervisory commissioners turn their backs on the public to cultivate reputation, and none show concern, yet he alone embodies the emperor's intent and should receive added reward.

sentences.zh: 」乃下褒詔，且賜帛二百。

translations.literal: " An edict of commendation was issued, and two hundred bolts of silk were granted besides.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict of commendation was issued, and two hundred bolts of silk were granted besides.

sentences.zh: 入為鹽鐵副使，以右諫議大夫知澶州。

translations.literal: He entered service as Vice Commissioner of Salt and Iron, and as Right Remonstrance Grand Master served as prefect of Cazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as Vice Commissioner of Salt and Iron and, as Right Remonstrance Grand Master, served as prefect of Cazhou.

sentences.zh: 坐失舉，降太常少卿。

translations.literal: For failing in selection he was demoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: For a failure in selection he was demoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 河決，晝夜捍禦。

translations.literal: The river broke; day and night he defended against it.
translations.idiomatic: When the river breached its banks, he worked day and night to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 神宗念其勞，復故官太中大夫，判將作監，轉正議大夫致仕。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong, mindful of his labors, restored his former office of Grand Master of Palace Administration, assigned him as vice-director of the Directorate of Palace Construction, transferred him to Right Grand Master of Discussion, and granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of his exertions, Emperor Shenzong restored him to his former rank of Grand Master of Palace Administration, assigned him to the Directorate of Palace Construction, then transferred him to Right Grand Master of Discussion and granted retirement.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: He died at age seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 璹吏事絕人，閱按牘，終身不忘，澶州民懷思之。

translations.literal: Shu's administrative ability surpassed others; having once reviewed a case file, he never forgot it throughout his life, and the people of Cazhou cherished his memory.
translations.idiomatic: Shu's administrative talent surpassed all others; once he had reviewed a case file, he never forgot it for the rest of his life, and the people of Cazhou cherished his memory.

sentences.zh: 他日，郡守或欲有所為，民必曰：「此已經韓太中矣。

translations.literal: On another day, when the prefect wished to undertake something, the people would invariably say, "This matter has already gone before Grand Master Han of the Palace Administration.
translations.idiomatic: On another occasion, when the prefect wished to undertake something, the people would invariably say, "This matter has already been handled by Grand Master Han of the Palace Administration.

sentences.zh: 」以故輒止。

translations.literal: " For this reason he would invariably desist.
translations.idiomatic: " For this reason he would invariably abandon the plan.

sentences.zh: 杜純，字孝錫，濮州鄄城人。

translations.literal: Du Chun, styled Xiaoxi, was a man of Juancheng in Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chun, whose courtesy name was Xiaoxi, came from Juancheng in Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 少有成人之操，伯父沒官南海上，其孤弱，柩不能還。

translations.literal: From youth he possessed the conduct of a mature man. His uncle died in office on the South Sea coast; his orphans were weak, and the coffin could not be returned.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he showed the bearing of a grown man. His uncle had died in office on the South Sea coast, leaving weak orphans behind, and the coffin could not be brought home.

sentences.zh: 純白父請往，如期而喪至。

translations.literal: Chun told his father and volunteered to go; the coffin arrived on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Chun told his father and volunteered to go fetch it; the coffin arrived right on schedule.

sentences.zh: 以蔭為泉州司法參軍。

translations.literal: By inherited privilege he was made judicial adjutant of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Through inherited privilege he was appointed judicial adjutant of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 泉有蕃舶之饒，雜貨山積。

translations.literal: Quanzhou had the wealth of foreign ships; miscellaneous goods piled up like mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhou enjoyed the riches of foreign shipping, and miscellaneous goods piled up like mountains.

sentences.zh: 時官於州者私與為市，價十不償一，惟知州關詠與純無私買，人亦莫知。

translations.literal: Officials serving in the prefecture privately traded with them, getting one-tenth of value or less. Only Prefect Guan Yong and Chun did not buy privately, though no one knew this.
translations.idiomatic: Officials serving in the prefecture privately traded with them at a tenth of fair value or less. Only Prefect Guan Yong and Chun refrained from private purchases, though no one knew it at the time.

sentences.zh: 後事敗，獄治多相牽繫，獨兩人無與。

translations.literal: Later when the affair was exposed, the investigation implicated many, but these two alone were uninvolved.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the affair was exposed, the investigation implicated many, but these two alone were not involved.

sentences.zh: 詠猶以不察免，且檄參對。

translations.literal: Yong was nevertheless dismissed for failure to supervise, and was summoned by edict to answer charges.
translations.idiomatic: Yong was nevertheless dismissed for failing to supervise, and was summoned by edict to answer the charges.

sentences.zh: 純憤懣，陳書使者為訟冤，詠得不坐。

translations.literal: Chun, indignant, submitted a letter to the envoy pleading Yong's innocence, and Yong was not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Indignant, Chun submitted a letter to the envoy pleading Yong's innocence, and Yong was not punished.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，以河西令上書言政，王安石異之，引置條例司，數與論事，薦於朝，充審刑詳議官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, as magistrate of Hexi he submitted a memorial on government policy. Wang Anshi was impressed and brought him into the Office of Regulation. He often deliberated with him and recommended him to court, appointing him detailed deliberation officer of the Office for the Scrutiny of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xining era, while serving as magistrate of Hexi he submitted a memorial on government policy. Wang Anshi was impressed, brought him into the Office of Regulation, often deliberated with him, and recommended him to court, appointing him detailed deliberation officer of the Office for the Scrutiny of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 或議復肉刑，先以刖代死刑之輕者，純言：「今盜抵死，歲不減五十，以死懼民，民常不畏，而況於刖乎？

translations.literal: Some proposed restoring corporal mutilation, first using amputation to replace lighter death sentences. Chun said, "Today thieves are punished by death, and the number each year does not fall below fifty. Using death to frighten the people — the people are often not afraid; how much less would they fear amputation?
translations.idiomatic: Some proposed restoring corporal mutilation, beginning with amputation in place of lighter death sentences. Chun said, "Today thieves are punished by death, and the number each year does not fall below fifty. If death itself does not frighten the people, how much less would amputation?

sentences.zh: 人知不死，犯者益眾，是為名輕而實重也。

translations.literal: When people know they will not die, offenders will only grow more numerous — that is to make the name light but the reality heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Once people know they will not die, offenders will only grow more numerous — that is to make the penalty seem lighter in name while making it heavier in reality.

sentences.zh: 」事遂寢。

translations.literal: " The matter was then shelved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was then shelved.

sentences.zh: 秦帥郭逵與其屬王韶成訟，純受詔推鞫，得韶罪。

translations.literal: Qin commander Guo Kui and his subordinate Wang Shao brought suit against each other. Chun received an edict to investigate and found Shao guilty.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin commander Guo Kui and his subordinate Wang Shao brought suit against each other. Chun received an edict to investigate and found Shao guilty.

sentences.zh: 安石主韶，變其獄，免純官。

translations.literal: Anshi favored Shao, overturned the case, and dismissed Chun from office.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi favored Shao, overturned the verdict, and dismissed Chun from office.

sentences.zh: 韓絳為相，以檢詳三司會計。

translations.literal: When Han Jiang became chief councilor, he was made inspector and reviewer of the Three Departments' accounts.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Jiang became chief councilor, Chun was appointed inspector and reviewer of the Three Departments' accounts.

sentences.zh: 安石再來，乃請監池州酒。

translations.literal: When Anshi returned to power, he requested supervision of wine production in Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Anshi returned to power, Chun requested appointment as supervisor of wine production in Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，為大理正。

translations.literal: After a long time, he was made chief of the Office of the Grand Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval, he was appointed chief of the Office of the Grand Censor.

sentences.zh: 上言：「朝廷非不惡告訐，而有覘事者以擿抉隱微，蓋京師聚萬姓，易以宿奸，於計當然，非擾人也。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial: "The court does not fail to loathe denunciation, yet there are those who watch for affairs to expose hidden wrongs — for the capital gathers myriad households and harbors long-established villains; such a policy is appropriate in principle, not a harassment of the people.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: "The court does not fail to loathe denunciation, yet there are those who watch for affairs in order to expose hidden wrongs. The capital gathers myriad households and harbors long-established villains, so such a policy is appropriate in principle and is not meant to harass the people.

sentences.zh: 比來或徒隸觖望，或民相怨仇，或意冒告賞，但泛云某有罪，某知狀，官不識所逮之囚，囚不省見逮之故。

translations.literal: Lately, either convict laborers nursing grievances, or common people bearing mutual grudges, or those hoping falsely to claim reward for reporting — they would merely say vaguely that so-and-so has committed a crime, so-and-so knows the circumstances; officials do not know which prisoner is to be seized, and prisoners do not understand why they are seized.
translations.idiomatic: Lately, whether convict laborers nursing grievances, common people bearing mutual grudges, or those hoping falsely to claim reward for reporting, they merely say vaguely that so-and-so has committed a crime and so-and-so knows the circumstances. Officials do not know which prisoner is to be seized, and prisoners do not understand why they have been seized.

sentences.zh: 若許有司先計其實，而坐為欺者以誣告，當無不竟矣。」

translations.literal: If officials were permitted first to verify the facts, and false reporters were punished for malicious accusation, there would surely be no unfinished cases."
translations.idiomatic: If officials were permitted first to verify the facts and false reporters were punished for malicious accusation, there would surely be no unfinished cases."

sentences.zh: 隰州商尹奇貿溫泉礬有羨數，云官潤之，寺欲械訊河東。

translations.literal: At Xizhou, merchant Yin Qi transported hot-spring alum with surplus quantity, saying the officials profited from it. The court wanted to put him in fetters and interrogate him in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: At Xizhou, the merchant Yin Qi transported hot-spring alum in surplus quantity, saying the officials profited from it. The court proposed putting him in fetters and interrogating him in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 純曰：「奇情止爾，若傅致其罪，恐自是民無復敢貨礬，則數百萬之儲，皆為土石。

translations.literal: Chun said, "Qi's circumstances extend only this far. If we manufacture his guilt, I fear the people will never again dare deal in alum, and then stores worth millions will all turn to rubble.
translations.idiomatic: Chun said, "Qi's circumstances extend only this far. If we manufacture his guilt, I fear the people will never again dare trade in alum, and stores worth millions will all turn to rubble.

sentences.zh: 請姑沒其羨而釋其人。

translations.literal: I ask that we temporarily confiscate the surplus and release the man.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that we temporarily confiscate the surplus and release the man.

sentences.zh: 」曹州民王坦避水患，以車載貨入京，征商者以為匿稅，寺議黥坦，純復爭之，卿楊汲奏為立異，又廢於家。

translations.literal: " A man of Caozhou, Wang Tan, fleeing flood disaster, brought goods to the capital by cart. Tax collectors thought he was concealing taxes; the court proposed tattooing Tan. Chun again argued against it. Vice Minister Yang Ji memorialized that he was being contrary, and he was again dismissed to his home.
translations.idiomatic: " A man of Caozhou, Wang Tan, fleeing flood disaster, brought goods to the capital by cart. Tax collectors thought he was concealing taxes, and the court proposed tattooing him. Chun again argued against it. Vice Minister Yang Ji memorialized that he was being contrary, and Chun was again dismissed to his home.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，范純仁、韓維、王存、孫永交薦之，除河北轉運判官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, Fan Chunren, Han Wei, Wang Cun, and Sun Yong jointly recommended him; he was appointed vice transport commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanyou, Fan Chunren, Han Wei, Wang Cun, and Sun Yong jointly recommended him, and he was appointed vice transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 初更役書，司馬光稱其論議詳盡，予之書曰：「足下在彼，朝廷無河北憂。

translations.literal: When the corvée regulations were first revised, Sima Guang praised his deliberations as thorough and wrote him: "With you there, the court need not worry about Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: When the corvée regulations were first revised, Sima Guang praised his deliberations as thorough and wrote him: "With you there, the court need not worry about Hebei.

sentences.zh: 」純因建言：「河防舊隸轉運，今乃領屬都水外丞，計其決溢之變，前日不加多，今日不加少。

translations.literal: " Chun accordingly submitted a proposal: "River defense formerly fell under the transport commission; now it is led by the outer vice-director of waterways. Considering the risk of breaches and overflows, yesterday's dangers were no fewer; today's are no fewer.
translations.idiomatic: " Chun accordingly submitted a proposal: "River defense formerly fell under the transport commission; now it is led by the outer vice-director of waterways. Considering the risk of breaches and overflows, the dangers were no fewer before than they are today.

sentences.zh: 然出財之司，則常憂費而緩不急；

translations.literal: Yet the office that disburses funds constantly worries about expense and delays what is urgent;
translations.idiomatic: Yet the office that disburses funds constantly worries about expense and delays what is urgent;

sentences.zh: 用財之官，則寧過計而無不及，不如使之歸一。

translations.literal: while the office that uses funds would rather overestimate than fall short — better to unify them in one.
translations.idiomatic: while the office that uses funds would rather overestimate than fall short. It would be better to unify them in one.

sentences.zh: 」後如其言。

translations.literal: " Later it was done as he said.
translations.idiomatic: " Later it was done as he had proposed.

sentences.zh: 召為刑部員外郎、大理少卿，擢侍御史。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice and Vice Grand Censor of the Office of the Grand Censor, then promoted to investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice and Vice Grand Censor of the Office of the Grand Censor, then was promoted to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 言者詆其不由科第，改右司郎中，尋知相州，徙徐州，陝西轉運使。

translations.literal: Detractors attacked him for not having come through the civil service examination; he was transferred to right bureau director, then soon served as prefect of Xiangzhou, moved to Xuzhou, and became transport commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Detractors attacked him for not having come through the civil service examination; he was transferred to right bureau director, then soon served as prefect of Xiangzhou, was moved to Xuzhou, and became transport commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 還，拜鴻臚、光祿卿，權兵部侍郎，謝病，以集賢院學士提舉崇福宮，改修撰。

translations.literal: Returning, he was appointed Minister of Ceremonial and Minister of Imperial Entertainments, acting Vice Minister of War; citing illness, he was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies to superintend Chongfu Palace, then changed to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed Minister of Ceremonial and Minister of Imperial Entertainments and given acting rank as Vice Minister of War. Citing illness, he was made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies to superintend Chongfu Palace, then was changed to compiler.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十四，弟紘。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-four. His younger brother was Hong.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-four. His younger brother was Hong.

sentences.zh: 弟 紘

translations.literal: Younger brother Hong
translations.idiomatic: Younger Brother Hong

sentences.zh: 紘，字君章，起進士，為永年令。

translations.literal: Hong, styled Junzhang, passed the jinshi examination and served as magistrate of Yongnian.
translations.idiomatic: Hong, whose courtesy name was Junzhang, passed the jinshi examination and served as magistrate of Yongnian.

sentences.zh: 歲荒，民將他往，召諭父老曰：「令不能使汝必無行，若留，能使汝無饑。

translations.literal: In a year of famine, the people were about to leave. He summoned the elders and said, "As magistrate I cannot guarantee you will not leave; but if you stay, I can keep you from starving.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine, the people were about to leave. He summoned the elders and said, "As magistrate I cannot guarantee that you will not leave, but if you stay, I can keep you from starving.

sentences.zh: 」皆喜聽命。

translations.literal: " All gladly accepted his orders.
translations.idiomatic: " All gladly accepted his orders.

sentences.zh: 乃官給印券，使稱貸於大家，約歲豐為督償，於是咸得食，無徙者。

translations.literal: He then had the government issue stamped notes, enabling them to borrow from wealthy families on the promise that in a good year he would oversee repayment; thus all obtained food, and none migrated.
translations.idiomatic: He then had the government issue stamped notes, enabling them to borrow from wealthy families on the promise that in a good year he would oversee repayment. Thus all obtained food, and none migrated.

sentences.zh: 明年稔，償不愆素。

translations.literal: The next year the harvest was abundant, and repayment was made without delay.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the harvest was abundant, and repayment was made without delay.

sentences.zh: 神宗聞其材，用為大理詳斷官、檢詳樞密刑房，修《武經要略》。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong heard of his talent and appointed him detailed adjudication officer of the Grand Censor's office, inspector of the Military Affairs Commission's penal section, and compiler of 《Essentials of Military Classics》.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong heard of his talent and appointed him detailed adjudication officer of the Grand Censor's office, inspector of the Military Affairs Commission's penal section, and compiler of 《Essentials of Military Classics》.

sentences.zh: 以職事對，帝翌日語宰相，嘉其論奏明白，未果用。

translations.literal: When he answered on official business, the emperor the next day told the chief councilors he praised his clear deliberations and memorials, though he was not ultimately appointed to higher office.
translations.idiomatic: When he answered on official business, the emperor told the chief councilors the next day that he praised Hong's clear deliberations and memorials, though he was not ultimately appointed to higher office.

sentences.zh: 紘每議獄，必傅經誼。

translations.literal: Hong, whenever he deliberated on cases, always applied the meaning of the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Hong deliberated on cases, he always applied the meaning of the classics.

sentences.zh: 民間有女幼許嫁，未行而養於婿氏，婿氏殺以誣人，吏當如昏法。

translations.literal: Among the people there was a girl betrothed in childhood; before the marriage rites she was raised in her fiancé's household, and the fiancé's family killed her to frame another. The clerks would punish according to marriage law.
translations.idiomatic: Among the people there was a girl betrothed in childhood. Before the marriage rites she was raised in her fiancé's household, and the fiancé's family killed her to frame another. The clerks would punish the offender according to marriage law.

sentences.zh: 紘曰：「禮，婦三月而廟見，未廟見而死，則歸葬於家，示未成婦也。

translations.literal: Hong said, "According to ritual, a wife presents herself at the ancestral temple after three months; if she dies before that temple visit, she is returned for burial at her family's home — showing she was not yet a wife.
translations.idiomatic: Hong said, "According to ritual, a wife presents herself at the ancestral temple after three months. If she dies before that temple visit, she is returned for burial at her family's home, showing that she was not yet a wife.

sentences.zh: 律，定昏而夫犯，論同凡人。

translations.literal: In law, once betrothal is settled and the husband commits an offense, he is judged as an ordinary person.
translations.idiomatic: In law, once betrothal is settled and the husband commits an offense, he is judged as an ordinary person.

sentences.zh: 養婦雖非禮律，然未成婦則一也。

translations.literal: Raising the betrothed girl at home, though not in ritual or law, yet since she was not yet a wife, the principle is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Raising the betrothed girl in the fiancé's household, though not prescribed by ritual or law, is the same in principle since she was not yet a wife.

sentences.zh: 」議乃定。

translations.literal: " The deliberation was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: " The deliberation was then settled.

sentences.zh: 又論：「天下囚應死，吏懦不行法，輒以疑讞。

translations.literal: He also argued: "Prisoners throughout the realm who deserve death — clerks, being timid, fail to apply the law and repeatedly resort to doubtful verdicts.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued: "Prisoners throughout the realm who deserve death — clerks, being timid, fail to apply the law and repeatedly resort to doubtful verdicts.

sentences.zh: 夫殺人而以疑讞，是縱民為殺之道也。

translations.literal: To kill someone through a doubtful verdict is to show the people a path to murder.
translations.idiomatic: To kill someone through a doubtful verdict is to show the people a path to murder.

sentences.zh: 請治妄讞者。

translations.literal: I ask that those who use false doubtful verdicts be punished.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that those who use false doubtful verdicts be punished.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: " His proposal was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: " His proposal was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 擢刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Director of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，為夏國母祭奠使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, he served as envoy to offer condolences to the Xia state's regent mother.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era, he served as envoy to offer condolences to the Xia state's regent mother.

sentences.zh: 時夏人方修貢，入其國，禮猶倨，迓者至衣毛裘，設下人坐，蒙以黲，且不跪受詔。

translations.literal: At that time the Xia people were resuming tribute. Entering their country, protocol remained arrogant: those receiving him wore fur garments, set out seats for inferiors, covered him with a dark cloth, and would not kneel to receive the edict.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Xia people were resuming tribute. Entering their country, he found the protocol still arrogant: those receiving him wore fur garments, set out seats for inferiors, covered him with a dark cloth, and would not kneel to receive the edict.

sentences.zh: 紘責之曰：「天王吊禮甚厚，今不可以加禮。

translations.literal: Hong rebuked them: "The Son of Heaven's condolence rites are most generous; you cannot add to them now.
translations.idiomatic: Hong rebuked them: "The Son of Heaven's condolence rites are most generous; you cannot add to them now.

sentences.zh: 」夏人畏懼加敬。

translations.literal: " The Xia people, fearful, showed greater respect.
translations.idiomatic: " The Xia people, fearful, showed greater respect.

sentences.zh: 他日，夏使至，請歸復侵疆。

translations.literal: On another day, a Xia envoy arrived requesting the return of seized border territory.
translations.idiomatic: On another occasion, a Xia envoy arrived requesting the return of seized border territory.

sentences.zh: 紘逆之至館，使欲入見有所陳，紘止之，答語頗不遜，紘曰：「國主設有請，必具表中，此大事也，朝廷肯以使人口語為可否乎？

translations.literal: Hong went out to meet him at the guest house. The envoy wished to enter and have an audience to present something; Hong stopped him. The reply was quite insolent. Hong said, "If the state lord has a request, it must be fully set forth in a memorial — this is a weighty matter. Would the court decide yes or no on an envoy's spoken words?
translations.idiomatic: Hong went out to meet him at the guest house. The envoy wished to enter and have an audience to present something, but Hong stopped him. The reply was quite insolent. Hong said, "If the state lord has a request, it must be fully set forth in a memorial. This is a weighty matter. Would the court decide yes or no on an envoy's spoken words?

sentences.zh: 」隨語連拄之，乃不敢言。

translations.literal: " He repeatedly interrupted as he spoke, and the envoy dared say no more.
translations.idiomatic: " He repeatedly interrupted as the envoy spoke, and the envoy dared say no more.

sentences.zh: 遷右司郎中、大理卿，以直秘閣知齊、鄧二州，復為大理卿，權刑部侍郎，加集賢殿修撰，為江淮發運使、知鄆州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to right bureau director and Grand Censor of the Office of the Grand Censor; as Master of the Hidden Archive he governed Qi and Deng prefectures; again served as Grand Censor; acting Vice Minister of Justice; added as compiler of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; transport commissioner of Jianghuai; prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right bureau director and Grand Censor of the Office of the Grand Censor; as Master of the Hidden Archive he governed Qi and Deng prefectures; again served as Grand Censor; acting Vice Minister of Justice; added as compiler of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; transport commissioner of Jianghuai; and prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 獄繫囚三百人，紘至之旬日，處決立盡。

translations.literal: Three hundred prisoners were held in the prisons; within ten days of Hong's arrival, they were all tried and disposed of.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred prisoners were held in the prisons; within ten days of Hong's arrival, they were all tried and disposed of.

sentences.zh: 又以刑部召，未至，還之鄆。

translations.literal: He was again summoned to the Ministry of Justice, but before he arrived he was sent back to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He was again summoned to the Ministry of Justice, but before he arrived he was sent back to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘗有揭幟城隅，著妖言其上，期為變，州民皆震。

translations.literal: Once a banner was posted at a corner of the city wall bearing seditious words, threatening upheaval; the people of the prefecture were all alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Once a banner was posted at a corner of the city wall bearing seditious words and threatening upheaval, and the people of the prefecture were all alarmed.

sentences.zh: 俄而草場白晝火，蓋所揭一事也，民又益恐。

translations.literal: Soon the fodder yard caught fire in broad daylight — it was one of the things threatened on the banner — and the people grew still more fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the fodder yard caught fire in broad daylight — it was one of the things threatened on the banner — and the people grew still more fearful.

sentences.zh: 或請大索城中，紘笑曰：「奸計正在是，冀因吾膠擾而發，奈何墮其術中？

translations.literal: Some asked for a great search of the city. Hong laughed and said, "The wicked scheme lies precisely in this — they hope that through our being tied up in confusion it will break out. Why fall into their trap?
translations.idiomatic: Some asked for a great search of the city. Hong laughed and said, "The wicked scheme lies precisely in this — they hope that through our being tied up in confusion it will break out. Why fall into their trap?

sentences.zh: 彼無能為也。

translations.literal: They can do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: They can do nothing.

sentences.zh: 」居無何，獲盜，乃奸民為妖如所揣，遂按誅之。

translations.literal: " Before long a thief was captured — it was wicked commoners creating portents just as he had surmised — and they were investigated and executed.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long a thief was captured — it was wicked commoners creating portents just as he had surmised — and they were investigated and executed.

sentences.zh: 徙知應天府，卒，年六十二。

translations.literal: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Yingtian Prefecture and died at age sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Yingtian Prefecture and died at sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 紘事兄純禮甚備。

translations.literal: Hong served his elder brother Chun with complete propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Hong served his elder brother Chun with complete propriety.

sentences.zh: 在鄆州聞訃，泣曰：「兄教我成立，今亡不得臨，死不瞑矣。

translations.literal: While in Yanzhou he heard the death notice and wept: "My brother raised and established me; now he is gone and I cannot attend him — I shall not close my eyes in death.
translations.idiomatic: While in Yanzhou he heard the death notice and wept: "My brother raised and established me; now he is gone and I cannot attend him — I shall not close my eyes in death.

sentences.zh: 」適詣闕，迎其柩於都門，哀動行路。

translations.literal: " Just then he was proceeding to court; he met the coffin at the capital gate, and his grief moved all who passed.
translations.idiomatic: " Just then he was proceeding to court; he met the coffin at the capital gate, and his grief moved all who passed.

sentences.zh: 悉以奉錢給寡嫂，推其子恩，官其子若孫一人。

translations.literal: He gave all his salary to his widowed sister-in-law, deferred his own son's favor, and had one of his brother's sons or grandsons given an official post.
translations.idiomatic: He gave all his salary to his widowed sister-in-law, deferred his own son's favor, and had one of his brother's sons or grandsons given an official post.

sentences.zh: 宦京師時，里人馬隨調選，病臥逆旅，紘載與歸，醫視之。

translations.literal: While serving in the capital, his neighbor Ma Sui was awaiting selection and lay ill at an inn; Hong carried him home in his cart and had him treated.
translations.idiomatic: While serving in the capital, his neighbor Ma Sui was awaiting selection and lay ill at an inn; Hong carried him home in his cart and had him treated.

sentences.zh: 隨竟死，為治喪第中。

translations.literal: Sui ultimately died, and Hong arranged his funeral in his own residence.
translations.idiomatic: Sui ultimately died, and Hong arranged his funeral in his own residence.

sentences.zh: 或以為嫌，不自恤，其風義蓋天性云。

translations.literal: Some thought this improper, but he did not care for himself — such moral character was surely inborn.
translations.idiomatic: Some thought this improper, but he did not care for himself — such moral character was surely inborn.

sentences.zh: 杜常，字正甫，衛州人，昭憲皇后族孫也。

translations.literal: Du Chang, styled Zhengfu, was a man of Weizhou and a clansman-grandson of Empress Zhaoxian.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chang, whose courtesy name was Zhengfu, came from Weizhou and was a clansman-grandson of Empress Zhaoxian.

sentences.zh: 折節學問，無戚里氣習。

translations.literal: He curbed himself to pursue learning and had none of the habits of imperial affines.
translations.idiomatic: He curbed himself to pursue learning and had none of the habits of imperial affines.

sentences.zh: 嘗跨驢讀書，驢嗜草失道，不之覺，觸桑木而墮，額為之傷。

translations.literal: Once he was reading while riding a donkey; the donkey, craving grass, strayed off the path unnoticed and bumped a mulberry tree, throwing him off and injuring his forehead.
translations.idiomatic: Once he was reading while riding a donkey. The donkey, craving grass, strayed off the path unnoticed, bumped a mulberry tree, threw him off, and injured his forehead.

sentences.zh: 中進士第，調河陽司法參軍事，富弼禮重之。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, was assigned as judicial adjutant of Heyang, and Fu Bi treated him with great respect.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, was assigned as judicial adjutant of Heyang, and Fu Bi treated him with great respect.

sentences.zh: 積遷河東轉運判官，提點河北刑獄，歷兵部左司郎中、太常少卿、太僕太府卿、戶工刑吏部侍郎，出知梓州、青、鄆、徐州、成德軍。

translations.literal: He rose through posts including vice transport commissioner of Hedong, intendant of penal affairs for Hebei, left bureau director of the Ministry of War, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Ministers of the Imperial Stud and Treasury, Vice Ministers of Revenue, Works, Justice, and Personnel, and served outside as prefect of Zizhou, Qingzhou, Yanzhou, Xuzhou, and Chengde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through posts including vice transport commissioner of Hedong, intendant of penal affairs for Hebei, left bureau director of the Ministry of War, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Ministers of the Imperial Stud and Treasury, Vice Ministers of Revenue, Works, Justice, and Personnel, and served outside as prefect of Zizhou, Qingzhou, Yanzhou, Xuzhou, and Chengde Army.

sentences.zh: 崇寧中，至工部尚書，以龍圖閣學士知河陽軍。

translations.literal: During Chongning he reached Minister of Works and, as Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, governed Heyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongning era he reached Minister of Works and, as Academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, governed Heyang Army.

sentences.zh: 苦旱，及境而雨，大河決，直州西上埽，勢危甚。

translations.literal: There was severe drought; rain fell as he reached his jurisdiction. The Yellow River breached its banks directly at the upper embankment west of the prefecture — the situation was extremely perilous.
translations.idiomatic: There was severe drought, but rain fell as he reached his jurisdiction. The Yellow River breached its banks directly at the upper embankment west of the prefecture, and the situation was extremely perilous.

sentences.zh: 常親護役，徙處埽上，埽潰水溢，及常坐而止。

translations.literal: Chang personally supervised the laborers, moving to stand on the embankment; when the embankment collapsed and water overflowed, it reached only to where Chang was sitting and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Chang personally supervised the laborers, moving to stand on the embankment. When the embankment collapsed and water overflowed, it reached only to where Chang was sitting and stopped.

sentences.zh: 於是役人盡力，河流遂退，郡賴以安。

translations.literal: Thereupon the laborers exerted all their strength, the river receded, and the prefecture was saved.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the laborers exerted all their strength, the river receded, and the prefecture was saved.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十九。

translations.literal: He died at age seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 謝麟，字應之，建州甌寧人。

translations.literal: Xie Lin, styled Yingzhi, was a man of Ouning in Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Lin, whose courtesy name was Yingzhi, came from Ouning in Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 登第，調會昌令。

translations.literal: He passed the examination and was assigned as magistrate of Huichang.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the examination and was assigned as magistrate of Huichang.

sentences.zh: 民被酒夜與仇鬥，既歸而所親殺之，因誣仇。

translations.literal: A man, drunk at night, fought with an enemy; after returning home, a close associate killed him and then framed the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: A man, drunk at night, fought with an enemy. After returning home, a close associate killed him and then framed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 麟知死者無子，所親利其財，一訊得實。

translations.literal: Lin knew the dead man had no son and that the associate coveted his property; one interrogation revealed the truth.
translations.idiomatic: Lin knew the dead man had no son and that the associate coveted his property; one interrogation revealed the truth.

sentences.zh: 再調石首令，縣苦江水為患，堤不可禦，麟疊石障之，自是人得安堵，號「謝公堤」。

translations.literal: Reassigned as magistrate of Shishou: the county suffered from the Yangzi; dikes could not hold it back. Lin piled stones to block it; thereafter people lived in peace, calling it "Magistrate Xie's Dike."
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned as magistrate of Shishou, he found the county suffering from the Yangzi and dikes that could not hold it back. Lin piled stones to block the river, and thereafter people lived in peace, calling it "Magistrate Xie's Dike."

sentences.zh: 通判辰州。

translations.literal: He served as vice-prefect of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice-prefect of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 章惇使湖湘，拓沅州，薦麟為守，由太常博士改西上閤門副使。

translations.literal: When Zhang Dun was envoy to Hunan-Hubei and expanded Yuanzhou, he recommended Lin as prefect; from Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Dun was envoy to Hunan-Hubei and expanded Yuanzhou, he recommended Lin as prefect. From Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Lin was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 徭賊犯辰溪，麟且捕且招，一方以寧。

translations.literal: Yao bandits invaded Chenxi; Lin both captured and recruited them, and the region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao bandits raided Chenxi, Lin pursued them with capture and conciliation alike, and the region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 詔使經制宜州獠，降其種落四千八百人，納思廣洞民千四百室，得鎧甲二萬，褒賜甚渥。

translations.literal: An edict sent him to manage the Liao of Yizhou according to circumstances; he subdued four thousand eight hundred tribal groups, took in one thousand four hundred households from Siguang Cave, obtained twenty thousand suits of armor, and received very generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The throne dispatched him to manage the Liao of Yizhou as circumstances required. He subdued four thousand eight hundred tribal groups, brought in fourteen hundred households from Siguang Cave, seized twenty thousand suits of armor, and received lavish commendation and reward.

sentences.zh: 加果州刺史，知荊南、涇、邠二州。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title of Prefect of Guo Prefecture and made governor of Jingnan and the two prefectures of Jing and Bin.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the additional title of Prefect of Guo Prefecture and appointed governor of Jingnan and of the two prefectures of Jing and Bin.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，復以朝議大夫、直秘閣知潭州，加直龍圖閣，歷徙江寧、鳳翔府、渭桂二州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era, he was again made governor of Tanzhou with the titles of Grand Master of Court Discussion and Direct Associate of the Secretariat Archive; he was promoted to Direct Associate of the Dragon Diagram Hall and transferred successively through Jiangning, Fengxiang Prefecture, and the two prefectures of Wei and Gui.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Yuanyou era he was again appointed governor of Tanzhou, bearing the titles of Grand Master of Court Discussion and Direct Associate of the Secretariat Archive. He was then promoted to Direct Associate of the Dragon Diagram Hall and transferred in turn through Jiangning, Fengxiang Prefecture, and the two prefectures of Wei and Gui.

sentences.zh: 融江有夷警，將吏議致討，麟以計平之。

translations.literal: There was an alarm from the Yi in Rongjiang; officers debated sending troops to punish them, but Lin settled it by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yi raised an alarm in Rongjiang, officers debated a punitive expedition, but Lin resolved the crisis by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 戍兵從北來，不能水土，麟部土人使極南，而北兵止屯近郡，賴以全者甚眾。

translations.literal: Garrison troops coming from the north could not adapt to the local climate; Lin organized local people and sent them to the far south, while northern soldiers were kept stationed only in nearby prefectures — many lives were thus saved.
translations.idiomatic: Northern garrison troops could not endure the southern climate. Lin deployed local men to the far south while keeping the northern soldiers encamped only in nearby prefectures, and in this way saved a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 卒於官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 王宗望

translations.literal: Wang Zongwang
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongwang

sentences.zh: 王宗望，字磻叟，光州固始人。

translations.literal: Wang Zongwang, styled Pansou, was a man of Gushi in Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongwang, whose courtesy name was Pansou, came from Gushi in Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以蔭累擢夔州路轉運副使。

translations.literal: Through inherited privilege he was promoted in stages to Vice Transport Commissioner of Kuizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: By inherited privilege he rose in stages to Vice Transport Commissioner of Kuizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 哲宗即位，行赦賞軍，萬州彌旬不給。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, an amnesty was proclaimed and the army rewarded; Wanzhou went more than ten days without payment.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, an amnesty was proclaimed and the troops were to be rewarded, but Wanzhou went more than ten days without paying them.

sentences.zh: 庖卒朱明因眾怒，白晝入府宅，傷守臣，左右驚散，他兵籍籍謀兆亂。

translations.literal: The kitchen soldier Zhu Ming, exploiting the troops' anger, entered the prefect's residence in broad daylight and wounded the governor; attendants fled in panic while other soldiers muttered of impending rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: A kitchen soldier named Zhu Ming, riding the troops' fury, entered the prefect's residence in broad daylight and wounded the governor. Attendants scattered in terror while other soldiers murmured of rebellion to come.

sentences.zh: 宗望聞變，自夔疾驅至，先命給賞，然後斬明以徇，且竄視守傷而不救者。

translations.literal: Zongwang heard of the disturbance and raced from Kuizhou; he first ordered the rewards paid, then executed Ming as a public example, and also banished those who had watched the governor wounded without helping.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang heard of the disturbance and galloped from Kuizhou. He first ordered the rewards paid, then executed Ming as a public warning, and banished those who had looked on while the governor was wounded without lifting a hand.

sentences.zh: 乃自劾，朝廷嘉之。

translations.literal: He then submitted a self-censure; the court commended him.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted a self-censure, and the court commended him.

sentences.zh: 歷倉部郎中、司農少卿、江淮發運使。

translations.literal: He served successively as Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Granaries, and Transport Commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Granaries, and Transport Commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region.

sentences.zh: 楚州沿淮至漣州，風濤險，舟多溺。

translations.literal: From Chuzhou along the Huai to Lianzhou, wind and waves were treacherous and many boats were lost.
translations.idiomatic: From Chuzhou along the Huai to Lianzhou the wind and waves were treacherous, and many boats were lost.

sentences.zh: 議者謂開支氏渠引水入運河，歲久不決，宗望始成之，為公私利。

translations.literal: Critics had proposed opening the Zhi Clan Canal to draw water into the Grand Canal; the plan languished undecided for years until Zongwang finally completed it, to public and private benefit.
translations.idiomatic: For years officials had debated opening the Zhi Clan Canal to feed water into the Grand Canal without reaching a decision. Zongwang finally completed the work, to the benefit of both public and private interests.

sentences.zh: 代吳安持為都水使者。

translations.literal: He replaced Wu Anchi as Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: He replaced Wu Anchi as Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 自大河有東、北流之異，紛爭十年，水官無所適從。

translations.literal: Since the Yellow River had diverged into eastern and northern courses, contention had raged for ten years and the water officials knew not which way to turn.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Yellow River had split into eastern and northern courses, debate raged for ten years and the water officials had no settled course to follow.

sentences.zh: 宗望謂回河有創立金堤七十里，索緡錢百萬，詔從之。

translations.literal: Zongwang proposed returning the river to its old course and establishing a golden dike seventy li long, requesting a million strings of cash; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang proposed returning the river to its old course and building a golden dike seventy li long, requesting a million strings of cash. The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 右正言張商英論其誕謾，而宗望奏已有成績，遂增秩三等，加直龍圖閣、河北都轉運使，擢工部侍郎，以集賢殿修撰知鄆州。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrator Zhang Shangying denounced this as extravagantly false, but Zongwang reported that results were already evident; he was promoted three ranks, given Direct Associate of the Dragon Diagram Hall and Chief Transport Commissioner of Hebei, elevated to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works, and made Governor of Yanzhou as Academician Compiler of the Hall for Cherishing Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator Zhang Shangying denounced the plan as extravagantly false, but Zongwang reported that results were already in hand. He was promoted three ranks, given Direct Associate of the Dragon Diagram Hall and Chief Transport Commissioner of Hebei, elevated to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works, and appointed Governor of Yanzhou as Academician Compiler of the Hall for Cherishing Worthies.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: He died at age seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 元符中，治其導河東流事，以為附會元祐，追所得恩典云。

translations.literal: During the Yuanfu era, his project of directing the river eastward was investigated; he was deemed to have pandered to the Yuanyou faction, and the honors he had received were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanfu era his project of directing the river eastward was investigated. He was judged to have pandered to the Yuanyou faction, and the honors he had received were revoked.

sentences.zh: 王吉甫

translations.literal: Wang Jifu
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jifu

sentences.zh: 王吉甫，字邦憲，同州人。

translations.literal: Wang Jifu, styled Bangxian, was a man of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jifu, whose courtesy name was Bangxian, came from Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 舉明經，練習法律，試斷刑入等，為大理評事，累遷丞、正、刑部員外郎、大理少卿。

translations.literal: He passed the Mingjing examination, studied law thoroughly, passed the criminal adjudication examination at full rank, and served as Assessor in the Court of Judicial Review, rising successively to Vice Director, Director, Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice, and Vice President of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the Mingjing examination, trained thoroughly in law, and passed the criminal adjudication examination at full rank. He served as Assessor in the Court of Judicial Review and rose successively to Vice Director, Director, Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice, and Vice President of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 舒亶以官燭引至第，執政欲坐以自盜。
